study: Coyne et al. 2013 — Early Reading Intervention (ERI) replication cluster RCT (vs school-designed active comparison)
delivery_evidence: Two in-person professional development days for interventionists led by the Project ERI research team (1st day before the intervention, 2nd after early lessons), plus in-person fidelity observations; no online/remote PD component. (ERI Training section, p. ~9)
test_alignment_evidence: All extracted outcomes are proximal norm-referenced early-reading subtests (WRMT-R/NU letter names/sounds/word ID/word attack, CTOPP sound matching/blending, DIBELS PSF/NWF) that narrowly target the specific phonemic-awareness/decoding skills ERI taught. (Table 10, p. 18; measures section)
curriculum_evidence: PD is tied to delivering ERI (Pearson/Scott Foresman, 2004), a commercially available 126-lesson supplemental beginning-reading curriculum with scripted lessons/materials that interventionists use. (ERI program description; 'commercially available' p. ~5)
outcome_timing_evidence: All 8 extracted outcomes measured at posttest in May, immediately after the ~100-session intervention; no delayed follow-up wave extracted. (Table 10, p. 18; timepoint 'post (May)')
